scriptComments: Sets first position to the first none outer wall tile
Fills the entire grid up with walls - and also states that we havent yet visited that tile - this comes into play later.
checks if the surrounding walls to see which haven't been visited yet
same as above but horizontal pathway - and if the tile left of the current one hasnt been visited yet
creates a vertical pathway through a wall if the tile above the current tile hasnt been selected yet
same as above - tile to right
A rather clumsy way to add walls to every "outside" grid space -  i.e. the mazes border.Also states that these have been visited - this stops the maze from making pathways here
checks if theres any tiles we haven't been to yet.
if we haven't visited all the tiles...looks like we have to go back and do some more tile checksotherwise it finishes up  and we have our maze
